info.title: Paperboat Server API
info.description: Production control-plane HTTP API for Paperboat dashboard and CLI clients.

bearerRefresh.description: Rotating refresh token accepted only by the refresh endpoint.

bearerEdgeControl.description: Private edge-control service credential. Never exposed to browser or CLI clients.

bearerMachineControl.description: Renewable machine_control credential for stable hostd, paired with the exact machine identity and signed request proof.

bearerHelperIdentity.description: Short-lived helper identity credential bound to the helper Ed25519 key.

TunnelRouteTLS.description: HTTPS verification policy. system is the secure default. custom_ca and optional mTLS values are opaque credential references, never PEM or private-key material. insecure_development is rejected unless explicit development policy permits and audits it.

server_name.description: TLS SNI and certificate hostname; independent of the HTTP Host header.

client_credential_reference.description: Optional mTLS client identity reference, orthogonal to system or custom_ca verification.

OriginCredentialReference.description: Opaque write-only secret-store reference. Raw PEM, keys, bearer tokens, query strings, and filesystem paths are forbidden.

host_override.description: Origin HTTP Host override; independent of TLS server_name/SNI.

stable_endpoint_id.description: Server-owned immutable canonical UUID for the tunnel managed endpoint; the host must never derive it from a name or host identity.

credential_generation.description: Server-reserved immutable generation bound to operation; the host must never guess it.

process_generation.description: Server-reserved immutable generation bound to operation; the host must never guess it.

credential_thumbprint.description: RFC 7638 Ed25519 JWK thumbprint without the ed25519: key-ID prefix.

credential_proof.description: Unpadded base64url Ed25519 proof over the enrollment transcript.

scope.const: account:read clients:revoke diagnostics:upload operations:read operations:write previews:read previews:write projects:connect projects:read session:refresh tunnels:read tunnels:write

version.description: Current project version. Required when If-Match is not supplied.

endpoints.description: Exactly one authority-only tls:// endpoint and one authority-only quic:// endpoint.

stable_endpoint_id.description: Server-owned immutable canonical UUID for the tunnel managed endpoint; the connector must not derive it from a name or host identity.

carriers.description: One to four carriers with distinct failure_domain values and distinct edge_node_id/edge_process_epoch pairs.

expires_at.description: Strictly after issued_at and no more than two minutes later.

envelope.description: Canonical unpadded base64url manager-signed opaque COSE manifest.

ConnectorControlSubprotocol.name: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol
ConnectorControlSubprotocol.description: The only accepted connector control WebSocket subprotocol.

MachineIdentity.name: X-Paperboat-Machine-Identity
MachineIdentity.description: Durable host identity credential used with the signed machine proof.

MachineProof.name: X-Paperboat-Machine-Proof
MachineProof.description: Strict unpadded base64url proof over the exact request body and idempotency key.

MachineIdentityOptional.name: X-Paperboat-Machine-Identity
MachineIdentityOptional.description: Renewable host identity credential. Required with MachineProof for owner-host preview creation.

MachineProofOptional.name: X-Paperboat-Machine-Proof
MachineProofOptional.description: Strict unpadded base64url proof over the exact preview create method, path, and body.

PrivateAccessGrant.name: X-Paperboat-Private-Access-Grant
PrivateAccessGrant.description: Short-lived signed grant returned by the grant endpoint. Never log or persist it.

ETag.description: Strong resource validator. The value is bound to the resource kind, ID, and generation.

Location.description: Operation resource to poll while the mutation is pending.

OperationID.description: Durable server create operation identity. Hosts use this value to resume an exact replay; it is not part of the preview resource.

post.summary: Discover the complete current same-account private route snapshot

post.description: Edge-only. The exact authenticated node and process epoch receive authoritative assignment IDs, configuration hashes, route match metadata, accessor keys, and every generation fence.

post.summary: Issue one short-lived private access grant
post.description: Stable-host-only. Verifies the renewable machine_control credential and X-Paperboat-Machine-Proof over the exact method, path, and body. Accessor account, machine, and installation identity are server-derived and signed into the short-lived grant.
Edge-only. Verifies the signed grant and rechecks the current account, route, carrier, generation, revocation, and edge process binding. Denials do not disclose resource existence.

post.description: Exchanges a short-lived Fly-signed OIDC workload identity obtained from the Machine-local API. The verified Fly app and machine ID must map to an active canonical hosted environment; no bootstrap secret is stored in the Machine configuration.

Requires a current helper identity and Ed25519 request proof. Returns the selected setup-script revision and, when the project source is private, a short-lived repository-scoped read credential. The response is never stored in Fly Machine configuration and is marked no-store.

Requires a fresh Ed25519 proof over the exact operation request. The active helper and its stored public key are resolved from the signed proof, so renewal remains available after arbitrarily long outages without an expired bearer token. Exact operation replays return the same encrypted-at-rest result.
Accepts a current or recently expired machine-control bearer credential and an exact Ed25519 request proof from the registered machine key.

post.summary: Issue the initial machine control credential
post.description: Exchanges the enrolled helper identity, bound to the machine key and environment, for the first renewable machine-control credential. Repeating the same operation after a local crash returns the same server-issued credential.

post.description: Requires the active helper identity and an Ed25519 proof over the exact request. Transitions only the matching installing or connecting enrollment to failed_retryable.
Private helper identity and proof endpoint. Returns a short-lived credential bound to the active assignment and warning revision.

post.summary: Acquire an exclusive config-repository writer lease
post.description: Machine-proof authenticated endpoint. Eligibility, assignment, warning revision, installation generation, and repository are revalidated before issuing a monotonic fencing token.

post.summary: Renew an exclusive config-repository writer lease
post.description: Renews only a current, eligible holder matching the lease ID and fencing token.

post.summary: Release an exclusive config-repository writer lease
post.description: Idempotently releases only the current eligible holder matching the lease ID and fencing token.
Machine-proof authenticated endpoint. Accepts only bounded, monotonic status bound to the current environment, assignment, repository, installation generation, and warning revision.

Requires both the helper identity proof and current config-sync credential. Returns one GitHub App installation token restricted to the assigned repository; provider authorization never reaches the helper.

post.summary: Read the assignment-bound config runtime policy
post.description: Requires helper identity proof and a current assignment-bound config credential. Returns assignment mode, plaintext manifest contract and limits, and the authoritative sync-revision floor needed to preserve monotonic status across restarts.

get.description: Returns the authenticated account's temporary preview leases in stable cursor order. Preview leases are never restored after reboot.

post.description: Allocates a random temporary endpoint for the selected owner device and local target. The request cannot choose a vanity hostname. A dashboard may select another online owner; an owner host must additionally send its renewable machine identity and exact request proof so the server can derive the machine actor without trusting a CLI client-session ID. Pending dispatch or readiness returns the operation resource in data.

202.description: Preview lease persisted and waiting for readiness.

get.description: Returns one account-scoped preview lease and its separate allocation, edge, and origin states.

delete.description: Stops the temporary preview, releases its random endpoint, and is idempotent. The strong ETag prevents stopping a stale lease generation.

post.description: Extends the owner device's active preview lease up to its requested deadline.

The owner device reports real edge and origin readiness for a previously dispatched preview. Send the renewable machine identity as the bearer and X-Paperboat-Machine-Identity, and bind X-Paperboat-Machine-Proof to the exact method, path, body, installation generation, and server create operation. Idempotency-Key is the server create operation ID. Browser sessions cannot complete this generation CAS.

200.description: Updated preview lease after readiness observation.

post.summary: Allocate a canonical preview carrier attachment
post.description: Allocates a short-lived machine-owned preview carrier binding without creating a durable tunnel. The request is authenticated by the renewable machine identity and exact create operation.

get.description: Returns a bounded JSON event page by default. Send Accept: text/event-stream to receive resumable SSE events; cursor and Last-Event-ID must agree when both are supplied.

202.description: Tunnel desired state persisted and waiting for readiness.

delete.description: Marks the tunnel deleted, preserving its audit history while connector and route cleanup proceeds. Deletion is idempotent and never reassigns the identity.

delete.description: Idempotently revokes a connector and leaves bounded session cleanup to the operation.

get.description: Upgrades WSS using paperboat.connector.v1. The first binary connector-v1 frame must be a signed Hello and is the sole authentication exchange. Query parameters, cookies, browser sessions, bearer authorization, and alternate authentication headers are not accepted. The path identities are routing fences and must equal the signed Hello identity.

101.description: WebSocket upgraded. Binary messages carry connector-v1 length-prefixed frames without compression.

400.description: The path, query, upgrade request, or required subprotocol is invalid.

post.description: Host-only, no-store bootstrap authenticated by the current renewable machine identity and detached proof over the exact method, path, and body. Idempotency-Key binds the proof operation. Browser sessions, cookies, bearer credentials, and query credentials cannot authorize it. The response binds every identity and generation fence to the active signed control session and contains no private key, token, cookie, authorization value, or reusable proof.

200.description: One-to-four current failure-domain carrier bindings for the exact active session.

400.description: Malformed, unknown, missing, or invalid request field.

401.description: The renewable machine identity or proof is missing or malformed.

403.description: The proven machine, account, host, or operation is not authorized for the active session.

409.description: The session, process, config generation, or content hash is stale; reconnect before retry.

503.description: No valid current carrier is ready or connector control is unavailable.

post.description: Returns a short-lived secret once to an authorized host. Only its hash and scope are persisted; browsers must not model or consume the token.

Host-only exchange requiring the signed machine proof bound to the exact body and idempotency key. Returns the secret-free, server-reserved credential and process generations for the first signed Hello. Both are immutable and bound to the running connector operation; the host must never guess either value. An exact idempotent replay returns identical activation data. The obsolete operation-only response is not returned.

202.description: Authoritative connector activation reserved and awaiting the first exact signed Hello.

post.description: Stops new work while allowing bounded existing sessions to complete. Forced close is reported explicitly when the deadline is exceeded.

post.description: Schedules a proven host identity rotation and retains the current credential until the replacement is verified. The response is operation-only; no fabricated secret or host-local key reference is returned.

post.description: Exchanges the pairing verifier and the machine's stable public identity key for installation material. The first successful exchange consumes the pairing. A retry for the same identity can replay material while the enrollment is still installing; a protected resume can recover material for up to 24 hours after the original delivery. The runtime_enrolled assertion controls whether an existing helper identity may be reused; mismatched identities, completed enrollments, and expired recovery windows fail closed.

runtime_enrolled.description: Set true only when the protected resume journal confirms that this machine already persisted its runtime identity.
